programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: A Real Pain In The Neck
programmes.d: A man is rushed into the ER with a 16-inch bar protruding from his neck; doctors try to figure out how they can remove it.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Exorcism In The ER
programmes.d: A man goes into anaphylactic shock; a tough guy fears needles; a man stabs himself with a ninja sword; a patient believes she needs an exorcism.

An ER doctor is trying to solve why a student is having difficulty breathing, and what his fraternity brothers might be hiding; a man falls off a roof and is impaled by a shovel; a police officer has a heart attack that endangers the hospital staff.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Headaches & Zombies
programmes.d: A pregnant ER doctor is endangered by a seemingly invincible violent patient; an unexplained headache turns out to be life-threatening; a man with a fence post through his torso is brought into a busy ER in the middle of the night.
A harrowing cold case into the murder of a young woman is finally solved when officers retrieve a discarded coffee cup from a casino garbage bin.
A wealthy California inventor is found shot to death on his kitchen floor. Money is the motive, but all the suspects have airtight alibis.
Dayton Leroy Rogers, known as 'The Molalla Forest Killer,' is a serial killer who mutilated and killed at least eight women in the US.
Dennis Rader, known to the World as the BTK Killer, killed ten people, including young children, between 1974 and 1991 in Wichita, Kansas.
Divorcee Mathew McGough is taking his five-year-old daughter Shannon for an overnight camping trip.
Experienced climbers are in the Swiss Alps when they are caught up in a terrifying electrical storm.
In March 2002, when filming for a documentary they were making, 2 divers Melissa Armstrong and Captain David Tomlinson became stranded in the Pacific Ocean when their boat drifts away from them.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Delusional Bride
programmes.d: A pregnant woman can't get to the hospital in time and must deliver in the front seat of her car. A bride can't go through with her wedding because she feels possessed by creatures crawling in her head.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: My Head's Exploding
programmes.d: A patient with a severe headache is seizing, then bruises erupt on her legs, and her doctor has no idea why. A beautiful naked woman is behaving so oddly that her doctor assumes she's on drugs - but she's not

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Under Siege
programmes.d: Gripping tales of medical emergencies. Doctors must look after their own when a psychotic gunman enters the hospital and starts shooting staff. Dr. May is shot in the head! Can his colleague save his life?
A bloodbath inside a Beverly Hills mansion sparks a highly publicized investigation.
